Ratan Swarup Memorial Prize recipients at IIT Kanpur

October 11, 2026

The Ratan Swarup Memorial Prize is awarded to the outstanding all-rounder among graduating undergraduates at IIT Kanpur. I wanted to collect the recipients in one place because weirdly this list doesn’t really exist.
